provenance.note: Artifact IDs and producing steps taken from the shared-context artifact registry. Granularity records how precisely a final-snapshot artifact can honestly be attributed to a step.

granularities.exact_step: The artifact is produced at exactly this step.
granularities.workflow_only: The artifact is produced/revised across several steps of this workflow; a final snapshot cannot be divided among them.
granularities.inferred_step: The file is generated at one step and edited at the mapped step; attribution of the authored portion is inferred.
granularities.unattributed: No defensible mapping; counted in the unattributed accounting bucket.
